title: fileCypher
tagline: A file encryption and transfer services utilizing NFTs and Web3 technologies
description: fileCypher utilizes multiple web3 technologies to transfer encrypted files over the blockchain. A user can enter the receiving address and a message with their file on the site. It will then be received by the address entered with the message. It will eventually be launched on valist.
how_its_made:
The site is built on next.js with React. The team really worked hard to implement all these technologies and we intend to do so in the near future when we go live. We a re currently still in production.
